rule: Every fact has ONE owner. Before adding a fact, find its domain here. Never copy a value into another file: import it, generate it, or read it from the owner. canon/SOURCES_OF_TRUTH.md is rendered from this file (node scripts/sources-of-truth.mjs --write).

ownerKinds.file: A file in this repo is the owner; edit it there.
ownerKinds.record: A database content record is the owner; edit it through the content-record API.
ownerKinds.external: An outside system is the authority; the repo mirrors it and a live check proves the mirror.

domains.title: Email streams and sending domains

owner.note: Every email stream (transactional, lifecycle, founder, broadcast, inbox, cold) bound to provider, sending domain and address, reply-to, required headers, postal footer, consent, suppression, rate limit, approval and deliverability thresholds. The send gateway (apps/web/lib/email/gateway) and the mail rules in scripts/lib/external-api-guard.mjs read it. Cold never runs on jov.ie or the Resend account and is closed until Tim approves a cold path.

domains.title: Engineering wins and the numbers in engineering posts

owner.note: One record per measured engineering win with before/after, source, query, PRs and post-deploy receipts. Status is computed (scripts/lib/wins-ledger.mjs), never stored.

domains.title: Public numbers and proof stats (counts, speed, benchmarks, milestones)

owner.note: Definition of every stat: template, rounding, threshold, freshness SLA, fallback, methodology, legal class, visibility. Measured values are the proof-stats/observations content record, written only by apps/web/lib/proof-stats (hourly production refresh and /api/internal/proof-stats intake). Copy binds with {stat:<id>}; scripts/invariants/stat-claims fails hand-written numeric claims.

domains.liveAuthority: production database (counts), Public Profile Benchmark receipts (speed, agent score), founder-approved Summer cards (comparative claims)

stripe-prices.note: Every owner price must exist as an active recurring Stripe price in USD. Disabled until STRIPE_READONLY_KEY (restricted, read-only Prices) is added to the sweep. Max prices are legacy and not checked.

email-dns.note: Sending domains must publish SPF and DMARC. Switch the domain list to the stream registry when #23585 lands.

production-build.note: Production must not trail main by more than this; merged-but-unreleased state is drift.

vercel-env-names.note: Vercel env names are compared with the credentials registry by the daily credentials check (unclaimed secret names); this map points to it instead of duplicating it.

model-lists.note: Provider model lists are checked by the model-registry-sync worker.
